sections.h2: Stain or paint? The first decision
body: Most fences in Lake City subdivisions are pressure-treated wood privacy fences, while the older homes near downtown sometimes have painted pickets. That split usually decides the finish. Raw or previously stained wood takes a penetrating stain, which soaks in and won't peel. Paint makes sense when the fence is already painted or you want a crisp color to match the house trim. Switching from paint to stain means stripping the old film first, so we talk through that before quoting fence painting in Lake City, FL.

Months of sun turn untreated wood gray and fuzzy, and the shaded sides grow mildew. We clean the boards, let them dry, and treat the mildew at the root before anything gets applied. Our article on treating a sun-damaged wood fence was written for neighboring Alachua County, but the same problems show up on Lake City fences.

Loose pickets, popped fasteners, and cracked rails are fixed before finishing. If a post is rotted at the ground line, staining it won't help. We'll point it out during the walkthrough so you can decide what to do before any money goes into finishing.

Fences along the street side of a lot also catch sprinkler spray every morning. Those lower boards stay damp longer, so we check their moisture before staining and mark them in the photo set that goes with your estimate.

Fences have a lot of edges, gaps, and end grain. We spray for speed and back-brush so the stain gets into the joints and the faces of each board. Shrubs and grass along the fence line are protected or tied back, and stain is kept off the house and driveway.
bullets: Both sides, where you have access

sections.h2: Coordinating with the rest of the yard
body: If the deck is staining at the same time, using one color on both makes the yard look intentional. See our deck staining in Lake City page for that scope. You can also find general guidance on our fence and deck staining page, or head back to the Lake City painting contractor page.

faqs.q: Can you stain the neighbor's side of my privacy fence?
faqs.a: We finish both sides when you have permission and access to the other side. If we can't reach it, the estimate lists it as excluded.

faqs.q: Is stain or paint better for a Lake City fence?
faqs.a: Stain usually works better on raw or previously stained wood because it soaks in instead of forming a film that can peel. Paint suits fences that are already painted.

faqs.q: Can you match the fence color to my house trim?
faqs.a: Yes. We can match from a chip or a leftover can and show you a drawdown first.

faqs.q: Do I need to wait after pressure washing before staining my fence?
faqs.a: Yes. The wood has to dry fully after cleaning so the stain can soak in. The drying time is built into the schedule on your estimate.
